ANALYSIS ONLY -- no params/config/trading-path file touched, no orders placed, no live tier flip regardless of verdict (see decision_rule.live_flip_deferred in the frozen pre-reg). Source: backtest/tools/bold_strike_axis_ab.py.

method_summary.exit_shape: SS_B_SHAPE (structure_stop_study.py), VERIFIED byte-identical to Bold's live-consumed ribbon_ride exit (strategies.py shared across accounts).

control_floor_collision.note: OTM-3's own floor-clearance rate -- the incident this study investigates.

disclosures: MEASURED (real OPRA local cache), not REALIZED -- scorecard/simulation-replay artifact, no broker fills exist for these strike/floor combinations.

Signals with no recoverable trigger_level fall back to SS-B's premium-only catastrophe-cap behavior (never dropped for that reason), per structure_stop_study's documented fallback contract -- same convention every study in this lineage uses.

min_entry_premium floor is checked against the RAW entry-bar OPEN premium (before entry slippage) -- the same fill-price proxy every study in this lineage treats as the plan-time premium; friction is applied only to trades that clear the floor.

edge_capture_rel (anchor gate) uses the account-agnostic J_WINNERS/J_LOSERS SPY-price-level pattern anchor (t4_exit_matrix.battery) at QTY=5 -- NOT directly comparable to OP-16's $1542 absolute or the Safe studies' QTY=10 figures (disclosed, not conflated); the gate itself (candidate_ecr >= control_ecr) is scale-invariant within this study.

Random-entry null is SEED-LEVEL (20 seeds, add-one empirical p_null over seed means), drawn from Bold's OWN (09:35,15:00) ET entry gate and routed through the identical shape/time-stop/floor gate as the real cells -- distinct from a generic coin-flip.
Risk-cap notional clamps (per_trade_risk_cap_pct, daily_loss_kill_switch_pct) are NOT modeled -- same disclosed gap every strike-AB study in this lineage carries.

ONE process, no multiprocessing.Pool (see prereg method.process_note) -- the in-memory per-symbol OPRA bar cache is process-local; concurrent workers would multiply cache misses, not parallelize usefully, on this data source.

near_miss_diagnostic._doc: Hand-authored interpretive layer appended AFTER the frozen-pre-reg run completed (same convention as strike-ab-convention-reconciliation.json's followup_2026_07_15 key) -- does NOT alter any gate/cell/decision value above; those are the script's own output, untouched.

wf_gate_structural_finding.observation: wf (walk-forward ratio) is null for ALL 6 cells, because wf is only defined when the IS-half (2025 calendar year) per-trade mean is POSITIVE (t4_exit_matrix.battery's own convention: `wf = oos_mean/is_mean if is_mean > 0 else None`), and EVERY cell's IS-half mean is negative under Bold's SS-B/honest-friction/floor convention while every cell's OOS-half (2026 YTD) is positive-or-near-zero. The gate is therefore UNREACHABLE by construction for this entire cohort+shape combination -- not a per-cell weakness.
wf_gate_structural_finding.cross_study_validation: This is NOT unique to this Bold run: analysis/recommendations/strike-ab-convention-reconciliation.json's job1a_strike_axis_honest_ssb (the SAFE account, same signal cohort, same SS-B shape, same honest-friction convention) shows `"wf": null` for ALL 4 of its cells too (OTM-2, OTM-1, ATM, ITM-2). Same convention, same structural gap, independently confirmed on both accounts -- strong evidence this is a property of (this cohort x SS-B x honest friction), not a bug in this script.
wf_gate_structural_finding.disposition: NOT patched here -- the frozen pre-reg named wf_ge_070 as gate 2 of 5 with zero post-hoc-adjustment language (kill_criteria discipline: no re-picks after seeing results). Flagging for a FUTURE queue item to reconsider whether wf_ge_070 needs a cohort-aware redefinition (e.g. a floor on n_is, or an alternate stability metric when is_mean<=0) BEFORE it gates any study again -- out of scope to fix retroactively tonight.

watch_tier_candidate.label: ATM
watch_tier_candidate.why_flagged: The ONLY cell that is sub_window_stable=true (both chronological halves net-positive: first +$563.4/119tr, second +$1420.8/120tr) AND clears BH-FDR AND clears the anchor AND clears floor >=70% both overall (0.9795) and afternoon (0.9688) AND beats OTM-3 control on OOS expectancy (+$28.77/tr vs -$14.37/tr). Fails ONLY gate 2 (wf_ge_070) -- the gate shown above to be structurally unreachable for this entire cohort, not a signal ATM specifically is unstable. exp_drop_top3=-$6.73/tr (still mildly concentration-dependent -- disclosed, not hidden) is the SMALLEST-magnitude negative among the 4 OOS-positive candidates (OTM-1 -$14.92, ITM-1 -$10.06, ITM-2 -$23.12), i.e. the least outlier-dependent of the group.
watch_tier_candidate.why_not_itm1_or_itm2_despite_higher_oos_: ITM-1 (+$94.48/tr OOS) and ITM-2 (+$86.05/tr OOS) both fail sub_window_stable with LARGE swings (ITM-1: -$5066.8 first half / +$6893.3 second half; ITM-2: -$4621.0 / +$4029.1) and both have full-sample expectancy that is barely positive (ITM-1 +$7.71/tr) or negative (ITM-2 -$2.56/tr) -- the eye-catching OOS number in both cases is a small number of concentrated days carrying the whole result (fable-too-good pattern: exp_drop_top3 negative for both). ITM-1 additionally fails BH-FDR (does not survive at alpha=0.10, rank 4/6). Neither is a stronger candidate than ATM once concentration risk is weighed, despite the bigger headline OOS number.
watch_tier_candidate.verdict_label: WATCH -- NOT ship-ready (fails the pre-registered 5-gate bar, specifically wf_ge_070). This is a near-miss worth a human/Fable look, not a same-night or same-morning auto-ship. Reported per the decision_rule's own null_result_is_valid clause.
